posts.subject: minimal brightness of Lenovo Legion 27U-10
posts.author: JhonCooper
posts.message_html: Hello can you say please what is minimal brightness of Lenovo Legion 27U-10 ? ( https://www.lenovo.com/lt/lt/p/monitors/legion/legion-27u-10-monitor/mong0014 ) and do eyes hurt after long sessions looking at this monitor, and is there a noticeable grain from anti-glare coating ?

posts.subject: Re:minimal brightness of Lenovo Legion 27U-10
posts.author: Lorenzo_Lenovo
posts.message_html:
Hello JhonCooper,

Welcome to Lenovo Community

I understand that you have concerns with your Lenovo Legion 27U-10's brightness.
For Legion monitors, usually, the minimum brightness level is approximately 50 nits. This allows for comfortable viewing in low-light environments.
Try adjusting the brightness to your preference thru the monitor's user guide via Direct Access Controls (page 2-3) or the Game Settings (page 2-6).
Ensure that the drivers are also up to date for better experience.
Hope this helps.

Best regards,
Lorenzo_Lenovo
